title: KNICKS DEADLINE CRISIS! Deuce & KAT Extension HOUR ZERO + $272M Question EXPLODES!
description:
The Knicks face their most critical deadline in years as August 11 looms for Deuce McBride and Karl-Anthony Towns extensions. With just 24 hours until the trade flexibility cutoff, neither star is expected to sign. Towns is eligible for $272M but the Knicks aren't offering the full max. McBride's $95M extension talks are silent. Meanwhile, Mitchell Robinson left for Boston, Andre Drummond turns 33 today as the backup center, and the second apron is forcing impossible decisions. We break down the August 11 ultimatum, the Brunson precedent, the Deuce dilemma, and whether this championship core can stay together.
